int_name: W HUNTING PARK AVE & OLD YORK RD

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation or planting strip.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width to narrow travel lanes, which can help reduce vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and well-maintained sidewalks leading into a park area. While traffic signals are present for vehicles, there is a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals, and the wide corner radii may encourage higher vehicle speeds during turns.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The wide geometry at the park entrance may allow vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning across the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the park road and the main street

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and traffic signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median or refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic during crossings.

hazards.name: Long crossing exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing time spent in the conflict zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crossing across the primary roadway in the center

hazards.name: Low-visibility crosswalk markings
hazards.description: Standard parallel line markings are less visible to approaching drivers compared to high-visibility continental patterns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing parallel line markings to continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

result.summary: The environment features a wide residential street with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and signalized control. However, the lack of a median and the presence of multiple travel lanes result in a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple travel lanes without a refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the zebra crossing

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb sides immediately adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.
